question: Italy's second hour in a new game: targets, sealift and the AI's generator.

addresses.name: CAIUnit_ManageLandUnits
addresses.comment:
**The land half of CAIUnit slot 73**, the third body it calls after CAIUnit_ManageAirUnits (0x4CD890) and CAIUnit_ManageNavalUnits (0x4D0880). Extent 0x4D57F0-0x4D7F7E, 10126 bytes, 2768 instructions, read end to end by walking every branch; two `ret 4` at 0x4D7F5B and 0x4D7F7B, both in the epilogue, so trap 3 does not apply. int3 x16 before it, int3 x2 and a fresh SEH prologue at 0x4D7F80 after. Trap 2: functionStart is wrong inside it twice (functionStart(0x4D6B45)=0x4D653C, functionStart(0x4D7D00)=0x4D78FB), both isolated 0xCC bytes. One dead 5-byte `jmp`+nop at 0x4D613B. One caller, slot 73 at 0x4B0D01: unconditional when the daily-stagger flag is set, otherwise one pass in three and only when at_war, in_undeclared_war or CCountry +0xF50 > 0. Return value set at exactly one place (0x4D7AB3) and never read.

ENTRY GATE: the topmost-agent test, then the +0x12C vector must hold at least one element, then **agent->+0x364 (frontier at a shooting war) and +0x366 must both be set** - so the whole function is dead for an agent whose operations area does not border an active war.

PHASE 1 (0x4D5944-0x4D678D) scores every enemy-controlled province of agent->front_provinces (+0xC0) into a fresh CProvinceFloat {vftable 0x15EB644, 0x18D, province id, float} inserted score-descending through 0x49C330. Base weight is a 0..500 ramp on map distance from the ops area's supply depot (flat 100.0 in arcade mode), x2 in an owner area of under 3 provinces, + half each enemy neighbour's plan-objective priority, + (operable land neighbours - 1) x 50 (x20 at stance 3, x10 at stance 4), +1000 for being on agent->+0x1BC and +500 for touching it, + 5*navalBase.level_max+100. At plan stance 3 or 4 only it also adds the province's own objective priority, 90 per plan-path province it is and 45 per one it touches (for both CUnit +0x244 and +0x258), 1000 when every operable neighbour is in agent->+0x1CC, **and agent->front_province_scores (+0x294)[province] through AIOrderedMap_SubscriptFloat at 0x4D5F6B - the single instruction that consumes CAIUnit::RebuildFrontAndApproaches's output, and its only reader in the image**; plus 125/250 for a thin enemy salient and 200/400 for a split approach, and x0.25/x0.5 for a redundant pocket approach (dropped outright below stance 3).

PHASE 2 (0x4D6795-0x4D7CB9) walks the targets best first. A score of 500 or more promotes the local stance to 4. Candidate units are the agent's own leaf land units (slot 15) standing in the target's friendly neighbours, filtered on fuel, ai_held_back, slot 86, combat state and pending destination; each is scored enemyNeighbours*10 - slot89(target,unit)*10 (+100 when slot88 > 95, /10 when it belongs to another agent, /5 when it has a blocking order) into **CUnit +0x2B8**, with the number of garrisoned unattacked enemy neighbours in **CUnit +0x2BC**. **The candidates are kept in ascending order of that score** - each goes in before the first candidate scoring more (0x4D7182 `ja`, CList_InsertBefore at 0x4D71CB), ties after - **and are added lowest first**, so the score is a cost: a unit whose own province has fewer enemy neighbours, and whose terrain attack+movement modifier at the target's terrain (slot 89, CAIUnit::GetUnitTerrainModifier with attacking=1) is higher, is tried first, and a unit rated a garrison above 95 (slot 88, CAIUnit::RateUnitAsGarrison) is pushed to the back. Slot 86 (CAIUnit::IsUnitReservedForTransport) is asked again of each candidate in the commit loop (0x4D7579), as well as in the candidate filter (0x4D6DAD) and of the stand-in (0x4D7768). Units are added while 0x4D93B0's odds figure does not fall; the attack goes ahead when the figure reaches 3.0 (1.1 at stance 4, 5.0 at stance 2 for admitting more units) and at least one attacker is movable, and is called off below 0.8 - both bars collapsing to 0.2/0.01 when the target borders two or more region groups or when an attacker is unsupplied and the target has a port. **A unit that cannot be spared from its own province gets `support_attack` (0x4D7AD6); every other one gets CEU3AI::MoveUnit (0x4D7AAE).**

PHASE 3 (0x4D7CBF-0x4D7F2C) sweeps agent->+0x11C's CUnit vector and stands down units whose attack is going badly - the combat's slot 17 (CCombat::GetAttackerStrengthShare, the attacker's share in thousandths) over 0.5 when the unit is on the defending side - i.e. its side is losing, the same sense as the naval body's complemented test, or a `support_attack` whose whole attacking side is pinned - but never one whose destination is on agent->+0x1BC. Standing down is CUnit::AIStandDown (0x49AAB0): a CSetOrderCommand for a null order where the order is not already null, the unit's movement_destination_province_id zeroed on the spot, and a CCancelMovementCommand - the unit halts in the province it stands in; nothing marches it back.

**Phase 3, the calling off, read again 2026-11-10** (`FINDINGS-liveread.md`, section 20): a land battle always answers that it may be left, so a unit falling back is called off a losing defence too; a support attacker (order type 0x4E5) is stood down when every attacker of its battle answers order slot 24, which a plain move and no order do not. **The bar, on the listing 2026-11-11** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 40): the stance at [ebp-0x38] picks 3.0 for 2 and 1.1 for 4 and 1.5 otherwise (0x4D7966; 0x162DC88, 0x151A2F0, 0x16279AC VA), 0.8 to call off (0x165C564); with [ebp-0xAC] > 1 - the distinct region groups (owner area +0x6C) of the target's friendly land neighbours, counted at 0x4D6868-0x4D69E2 - or the port flag [ebp-0x2D], 0.2 and 0.01. Each target's phase-one score is written into its CProvinceFloat at 0x4D670D. **The support flag measured 2026-11-12** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 54): a joining unit is flagged for support_attack where its +0x2BC is above nought, its province draws on a depot (+0x48 != 0), no stand-in stands there - a stand-in being of its own country or a co-belligerent not at war with it and not already in the attackers list - and its province is not in +0x1CC; so the last of three units in one province supports, and a lone flagged unit never attacks. **The candidate gathering read again 2026-11-12** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 58): with no pending destination (0x4D6C73) it jumps to 0x4D6D1D past the enemy-destination, garrison (+0x2C9) and nearest-agent tests, so a garrison or another agent's unit standing still is a candidate; the list is kept ascending by +0x2B8 (0x4D7186). **The dead end's sea, read 2026-11-12** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 59): a sea neighbour of the single approach counts only where p's template coast flag (+0xA0) is set and p has an edge to the same sea province (0x4D61C7); the rule goes on with fewer than 3 operable land neighbours and no such sea (0x4D624C).

addresses.name: CAIUnit::AssignAreaTargetsAndSealift
addresses.comment: **Which theatre area each land unit is bound for, and the plan's embark and debark.** Read whole on the listing, 0x4C4370 to the `ret 8` at 0x4C7530 (early `ret 8` at 0x4C43B4). One caller, CAIUnit::Tick at VA 0x8B0C38 (answer ignored), for the agent nearest above its unit, daily = (hour == (id+6)%24). Runs when the agent has a unit and (+0x5C is set - cleared here - or daily, or its CEU3AI does not run units). **Nothing at all unless the country owns at least one whole unit of transport capacity** (UnitList_SumTransportCapacity over CCountry +0xBAC >= 1). (1) Areas: the theatre's areas (+0x84) that are real, in order; per area need = EstimateAreaNeed(agent, area, .., relaxed) with relaxed = at war and not COwnerArea_TouchesHostileArea(area), halved (C division) when relaxed and the area is the acting capital's; have = CountDivisionsInArea(.., false) (divisions by Unit_GetAnchorProvince(.,1): target if set, else destination or position). (2) Each unit of +0x11C with a target whose area is real and not one of the theatre's: kept only if army_role 0 and the target is held by a country we CanOperateIn; else target cleared (CArmy +0x2E8 = 0 at once and CSetAIParamCommand(unit, 0, staging) posted) and, a division, counted where it stands. (3) Each theatre area with have > need: repeatedly the division (+0x300 clear) bound there that stands in a theatre area of positive need and is farthest from its target - or, with an embark set, any standing outside embark's area (10000) before those inside it (distance to embark) - is released the same way, until have <= need. (4) Each unit: a target that CAIUnit_MayShipUnitToArea no longer allows is released; one it allows is listed for sealift (weight += definition weight/1000), counting it toward the embark tally when bound for debark and standing in embark's area. A unit with no target standing in our own land outside the theatre's areas (or trespassing anywhere outside) is 'stranded' - a trespasser whose path ends in a friend's land has its target zeroed and is not. (5) Deficit list: per theatre area need-have, our areas sorted largest first (stable; an equal at the head with more provinces goes first), others' areas sorted the same way then pushed in front one by one (so reversed). Per area: want = max(deficit, stranded count where the area is not an enemy's and (touches a hostile area, or is the theatre's largest area, or with no theatre is first)); with want >= 1 the target province is CAIUnit_PickLandingProvince for an enemy-held area, else CAIUnit_PickPortNearestObjectives; then while want >= the next area's deficit (or the area is an enemy's and want > 0) the best unit gets it - CArmy +0x2E8 = province, CSetAIParamCommand(unit, province, staging) - marched with CEU3AI::MoveUnit(.., 0, 1, 1, 0) where CMapProvince::CanUnitReach(province, unit, 1, 1), else listed for sealift. Candidates: no target, anchor area real, CAIUnit_MayShipUnitToArea, not army_role 8 while the agent has air transports, not standing beside an enemy area that also touches the target area, not in a friend's land beside an enemy, own area not still needing it, the headquarters only to the largest area, a division; score = surplus of its own area (+10000 stranded; otherwise only while the deficit is >= 1), + slot 87 (enemy area) or slot 88 by the four touches-war cases (+x, +101-x), + 2 x slot 88 where the target area's +0x3C < 1, +100 where its parent is bound there and +50 per sibling bound there, x2 (CUnit +0x2C9 set) or x0.25 (standing on an ops-area province) where its own area borders an enemy; the strictly highest wins. (6) Every non-division of +0x14C with no target and not a theatre: target = CAIUnit_PickPortNearestObjectives of the area most of its land children stand in, where that is not its own, posted with staging 0 and no move. (7) Tail: +0xD4 = sealift weight; +0x58 = COwnerArea_LargestNavalBase of the theatre's largest area (no theatre: of the unit's area), 0 with no weight. Embark/debark cleared (CSetPlanTransportStateCommand(unit, 0, 0)) when only one is set or both are and nobody bound for debark stands in embark's area. While debark is unset, weight > 0 and the agent has naval transports (+0xEC): votes per listed unit for its target - 1, or 4 where its area's need < 1, +3 where its area holds a played-country objective (never for the AI), +10 where the target is not ours - the strictly best untried target is debark, embark = CAIUnit_PickEmbarkPort of the area (not debark's) where most of the units bound there stand, the strictly largest that yields a port; posted, or the target set aside and the vote repeated. With both set: every listed unit bound for debark standing in embark's area, not aboard, fighting or retreating, adds its weight and is boarded where it stands at embark (0x4D4070) or marched there; transports at embark with no busy order count their transport_capability/1000; while weight > capacity, the transport not at embark, with no blocking order, CUnit::CanMoveTo(embark), organisation >= 0.01, with the lowest ((1-strength)+(1-org))*2+1 times sea distance/1000 is sent (MoveUnit 0,0,0,0); the first idle transport in embark's port then runs 0x4D4D40 or, failing it, 0x4D42D0. Answers whether it posted the pair or moved/boarded anyone. Ghidra's own label on it, CSetAIParamCommand::CSetAIParamCommand_4, is wrong. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-moving.md, section F. **Read again 2026-11-11** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 43): logged live, it runs once after a load's second pass with +0x5C set (the constructor's seed). Step 4's embark tally compares embark's area (0x4C59B7) with the area of the unit's destination (GetMovementDestinationProvince, 0x4C5625), or of its province with none (0x4C5630) - stored at [esp+0x48], 0x4C5680 - not where it stands. **Live 2026-11-11** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 50): a unit's sealift weight is its rebuilt definition's +0x10C, so a land brigade of no width under 1.000 organisation - CUnit::RebuildDefinition's reduced path - weighs nothing; Italy's 4a Armata, an hq_brigade at organisation 0 waiting at embark 10731 entering July 1941, counts 0 troops (logged at 0x4C71E3) and no transport is sent. **A transport fleet is sent by CEU3AI::MoveUnit(fleet, embark, 0, 0, 0, 0)** at 0x4C7396 (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 57, read 2026-11-12) - before the tick's naval body, which then finds it bound. **Read 2026-11-12** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 59): an own area's record with the head's deficit and more provinces (+0x2C) than the head's area goes in front (0x4C5AF1), else the sorted insert 0x4DD740; the fill writes CArmy +0x2E8 at 0x4C6484 (unit EAX, province ESI); a transport fleet is sent at 0x4C7396.

addresses.name: CEU3AI_RankInvasionAreas
addresses.comment: **Rebuilds the ranked areas to invade at CEU3AI +0xC8** (nodes {area, score, distance, prev +0xC, next +0x10, byte +0x14}, kept by descending score through 0x49C240). Read whole, 0x895530 to `ret 8` at 0x8971B2. The list is freed first; nothing more unless UnitList_SumTransportCapacity(country units +0xBAC) >= 4 x infantry_brigade weight/1000. Candidates: an AI country takes every area (CCountry +0xD30) of every country in its enemies list (+0x1008) that is in_scenario, the area not landlocked - except that GER, when COwnerArea_TouchesHostileArea (0x7FD90) says its acting capital's area borders an enemy, considers only NOR, SWE, FIN, DEN; and when both we and the enemy are in a real faction (slot 7), never FIN and never the acting capital area of ROM, BUL or YUG. With an agent: the areas of the agent unit's plan objectives (CUnit +0x234) that are real, not ours, held by a friend or an enemy, not landlocked and holding none of the agent's front provinces (+0xC0). Reach: our areas, plus every non_hostile_countries (+0xF98) country's areas unless our capital's area borders an enemy; range 2000 if it does, else 5000. For each candidate A (controller C): over its non-landlocked neighbour areas B - B ours: A 'touches us', and B (unless our acting capital's area) goes on a list of staging areas; B held by X != C where A is C's acting capital area, X a friend (IsFriend false-flag), at war with C (or REB, or an undeclared war covering B's first province), not played, in our faction where both are in real ones, B's region group not our capital's, and (X our subject, or we are not JAP and X not JAP/POL/DEN, X no one else's subject): A 'touches us' and B is a staging area. Then: A in the failed list (+0x94) skips; an AI country's A that touches us goes on the failed list; CEU3AI_MayInvadeArea false -> failed; some port of A must reach (0xD52A0, flag 0) a port q of a reach area within range (int(float(naval distance/1000)) < range), q in our area, in ENG's acting capital area, or reachable within range from one of our own ports - else failed. Score: 100001 for an area holding a priority province (+0x118); else, a small island (ports' level_max summing >= 1, < 5 provinces, no land neighbour +0x3C) gives GER -99 before 1944 and otherwise 10 x port levels + 51; C's acting capital area gives min(provinces,100) + 1, halved when C is a subject; else 1. +900 for C = GER when the Soviet Union owns provinces and has surrender progress > 300 or manpower < 90, we being major or max_ic > 100, and A GER's capital area; USA vs JAP +200 (+600 more for a small island) unless that Soviet test held; JAP: vs USA small island +600, HOL +200, PHI +100. Then g = 120 for each of the map defines GIBRALTAR_BLOCKER and SUEZ_BLOCKER whose province lies in A (ENG and USA only), plus over A's first 60 provinces: 8 x naval base level_max, +40 with victory points, +30 yielding crude oil/metal/energy/rare materials, +40 with a strategic resource (+0x18 slot 14), +5 owned by us; g / (n/20) when n/20 > 1. total = g + f; k = max(fistp(total/5), 5) (6 or more kept); score = total + MT19937Next(AI generator) % k, divided by (0x81880(A, our capital area)/200) when that is positive, rounded by fistp. Kept to 10 by dropping the tail. Then staging areas: the priority areas held by a same-side or non-hostile (CDiplomacyStatus +0x58) non-enemy country are added; each not failed must pass AreaPair_SeaRouteOpen (0xD5760) (some port of our capital area reaches one of its ports while we are at war; always at peace) or goes on the failed list; one of ours needs >= 40 provinces in enemy-held neighbour areas (25 when one of them is its controller's capital area); score 500, or 10500 for a priority area, + AI-generator draw % max(fistp(score/5),5) - 5 x provinces, x2 for a controller's acting capital area; inserted with distance 0. Finally, entries scoring under the head's score / 10 are dropped from the tail. **Its draw (0x496A0B) is MT19937Next on the game state's +0x124**, the AI's generator and not the static one battles draw on (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 59).
